text: 1. Scanned copy of the information page of the valid passport2 Highest academic degree certificate. Fresh graduates should submit the expected graduation certificate (original scanned copy and English translation). After being pre-admitted, fresh graduates must submit their academic degree certificates to obtain the admission qualification.3 Transcripts of all courses in the highest academic education stage (original scanned copies and English translations)4. Study Plan in China Written in Chinese (for those applying for programs taught in Chinese) or English (for those applying for programs taught in English); The content includes personal study and work experiences, academic research achievements, research plans during the master's or doctoral stage, further education plans, and personal development goals after graduation, etc. Master's students should have no less than 1,000 words and doctoral students no less than 1,500 words.5 Two recommendation letters from professors or associate professors, which must be original in either Chinese or English (including signatures and contact information)6. Pre-admission letter from the Supervisor of Southern Medical University7. A list of published papers, abstracts, or other materials that can prove one's research ability8. Id photo (2-inch bareheaded photo with a blue background)9 Self-introduction video in English or Chinese (3-5 minutes, no more than 50M)10. A scanned copy of the "Physical Examination Record for Foreigners" (please keep the original for yourself), which must be filled out in either Chinese or English.11. Proof of language proficiency12. Scanned copies of the "International Student Financial Guarantee Form" and its guarantee materials, which must be filled out in either Chinese or English, and provide a deposit certificate sufficient to cover reasonable expenses such as study, living, and international travel during their study in China (the deposit amount should be no less than 150,000 RMB). And a scanned copy of the passport or identity document of the financial guarantor (only a relative of the applicant) (to be provided by applicants for self-funded projects)
